findings.message: Adding a public operator parameter whose only effect is to mute a log line is permanent API surface for a very small benefit, and with `default_deferrable=True` every POST task will now log a warning on every attempt. Consider making this a logger-level concern (users can silence `airflow.task.operators...HttpOperator`) rather than a new kwarg.

Hardcoding the `stable/` docs URL means the warning points at the currently released provider docs, which will not contain `deferrable.html` until this change is actually released, so the link is dead for everyone who hits the warning in the meantime. The docstring already carries the `:ref:`; consider dropping the raw URL or deriving it from the provider version.

`assert "issues/67945" not in message` (also repeated in `test_deferrable_warning_links_to_stable_docs`) asserts the absence of a string the code never produces. It looks like leftover scaffolding from development and will only confuse whoever touches this test next.
